offering_description.value: Refines crude oil into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel and other fuels at refineries in Hawaii, Washington, Montana and Wyoming. Sells fuel wholesale to distributors, airlines and businesses, and retail to motorists through stations and convenience stores, while operating pipelines and terminals that move and store fuel.

primary_products.value: gasoline; diesel; jet fuel; asphalt; liquefied petroleum gas

primary_services.value: fuel storage and terminaling; pipeline transportation; fuel distribution logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: fuel distributors, airlines, commercial fuel buyers, asphalt paving contractors; B2C: individual motorists buying fuel at retail stations and convenience stores

end_markets.value: transportation; aviation; construction; retail fuel; energy

revenue_model.value: product sales: refined fuels and asphalt sold wholesale and at retail; service fees: pipeline and terminal storage and throughput fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: refines purchased crude oil into finished fuels, sold to distributors and retailers; distributor: wholesales fuel to distributors, airlines and commercial buyers; retailer: sells gasoline and convenience goods to motorists at its own stations; asset operator: owns and runs refineries, pipelines and fuel terminals, serving fuel buyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; distributor; retailer; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: Hawaii, Pacific Northwest (Washington), Montana and Wyoming

specialization.value: related lines: refining, fuel logistics and wholesale and retail fuel marketing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated retail fuel stations and convenience stores; distributors / dealers: wholesale fuel supplied to independent distributors and dealers; direct sales: bulk fuel contracts with airlines and commercial customers
distribution_channels.category: own locations; distributors / dealers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental permits and emissions rules from state and federal agencies such as EPA, plus fuel safety and transport rules
